reason: The plugin provides a /fresh command that summarizes a conversation, creates a new session with the summary, archives the old session, and automatically navigates to the new session.

summaries.zh: 通过 /fresh 命令总结当前对话、创建继承工作上下文的新会话、归档旧会话并自动跳转到新会话。
summaries.en: Use the /fresh command to summarize the current conversation, create a new session with inherited context, archive the old session, and open the new one automatically.

capabilities: Summarizes the current conversation context using an LLM
Creates a new conversation inheriting the prior working directory and agent preset
Automatically opens the related new conversation in the client
